text:
The change adds a percentage-discount function and a test for a 10% discount on 1,000 cents.

The function can return fractional cents: 10% off 101 cents returns 90.9. Floating-point arithmetic can also turn an exact-cent result into 669.9999999999999 for 33% off 1,000 cents. This violates R2. The new test uses values that conceal both problems; the implementation needs a defined rounding policy and tests covering these cases.
